props: (5S,12R,6Z,8E,10E,14Z)-5,12-dihydroxy-6,8,10,14-eicosatetraenoic acid; (5S,6Z,8E,10E,12R,14Z)-5,12-dihydroxyeicosa-6,8,10,14-tetraenoic acid; (5S,6Z,8E,10E,12R,14Z)-5,12-dihydroxyicosa-6,8,10,14-tetraenoic acid; (S-(R*,S*-(E,Z,E,Z)))-5,12-Dihydroxy-6,8,10,14-eicosatetraenoic acid; 5(S),12(R)-dihydroxy-6(Z),8(E),10(E),14(Z)-eicosatetraenoic acid; 5(S),12(R)-dihydroxy-6(Z),8(E),10(E),14(Z)-icosatetraenoic acid; 5,12-Dihete; 5,12-Hete; 5S,12R-diHETE; 5S,12R-dihydroxy-6Z,8E,10E,14Z-eicosatetraenoic acid; LTB4

A leukotriene composed of (6Z,8E,10E,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid having (5S)- and (12R)-hydroxy substituents. It is a lipid mediator of inflammation that is generated from arachidonic acid via the 5-lipoxygenase pathway.
